description: A staged policy for handing learners control over goals, resources, pace and evaluation within a structured course, with a written plan, taught self-direction moves, dated check-ins and calibrated self-evaluation; no claim in this wiki tests the hand-over as such, and learner control alone showed a near-zero effect while self-pacing cost completion.
title: Self-Directed Learning

description: A reusable plan–monitor–act policy that makes regulation explicit with task-specific prompts, modelled self-assessment and a usable next action, then reads the response before handing regulation to the learner.
title: Self-Regulated Learning
